metadata.description: Claude Code mods: context window visualizations above the prompt

plugins.name: context-bars
plugins.description: Context window as one proportional bar above the prompt

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Context window forecast above the prompt (from anthropics/claude-code-playground)

plugins.name: y-change
plugins.description: Pane that shows each code change as a diff with a beginner-friendly explanation of why

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar of Claude's task list above the prompt

plugins.name: enhance-prompt
plugins.description: Rewrites each prompt for the AI, shows it above the prompt box, sends it only if you allow

plugins.name: mod-switch
plugins.description: Pane that lists the installed mods with a switch each to turn them on or off
